newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs eye U.S. jobs as gold, French vote sagas fade.
newsitem.headline: OLOs eye U.S. jobs as gold, French vote sagas fade.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds turned their attention to U.S. economic data on Wednesday, as the market gradually lost interest in the German gold and French vote stories which set the tone in the past week.

OLO futures BGBc1 eased nine basis points in line with Bunds FDBc1, failing to build on Tuesday's rally. Dealers attributed that rally to short-covering on talk about a German government-Bundesbank deal about the Bundesbank gold revaluation plan, but said they had seen no end-investor buying.
"The two big topics, gold and the French vote, are finished. Direction will have to come from the U.S.," one dealer said.
